Graduate Admissions
Graduate School FAQs
Why graduate school at Mizzou Engineering?
Graduate school brings students, faculty, postdoctoral scholars and staff together from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. You’ll become connected with an extensive network of experts from engineering and interdisciplinary areas. We’re conducting the latest research, developing new innovations and creating breakthrough technologies.
How do I apply for graduate school?
Prospective students who wish to earn a master’s, doctoral degree or stand-alone graduate certificate should complete the application for admission.
How do I pay for graduate school?
Teaching assistantships and research assistantships include a stipend and fully cover tuition, as well as providing professional experience and academic training. Learn more about graduate assistantships here. See MU and external fellowships here. The College of Engineering also offer competitive fellowships, including fellowships in specific departments.
How do I find more about faculty working in my research area of interest?
The best way to explore specific areas of research at Mizzou Engineering is by visiting individual department pages. You can find research focus areas, research centers and faculty directories in each department section of the web. In some cases, you can search by technical focus areas to see who’s working in specific research areas. You can also explore our research centers, labs and more using the “research” tab in the menu bar.
Where can I explore graduate programs in engineering?
The College of Engineering graduate programs promote technology, innovation and entrepreneurship with interdisciplinary opportunities. Explore our graduate degree program details and requirements here. Additionally, the MU Graduate School regularly offers for-credit courses to enhance your skills and knowledge.
What is Columbia like?
Columbia, Missouri, is half-way between St. Louis and Kansas City and is consistently named one of the best places to live. Our community provides a high quality of life and is an affordable place to live. With nearly 50 public parks, eight hospitals and heath care centers, more than 30 museums and 600 restaurants, there’s something for everyone. Learn more here.
Are there different admissions requirements for international students?
The application process for international applicants is similar to the process for domestic applications. International applicants do have to show English proficiency to be admitted and a minimum amount of financial support to be issued immigration documents. See more about the international application process here.
Can you waive the application fee?
We do not offer application fee waivers, however the MU Graduate School does in a few instances. Visit this page to learn more.
Are there opportunities to visit campus?
Yes. We can sponsor campus visits for select students. Please inquire at askengineering@missouri.edu.
For more information contact:
askengineering@missouri.edu
